package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestEnabledValidValue(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultBuildOptions()
	WithLabel("valid")(opt)
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
}

func TestDisabledInvalidValue(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultBuildOptions()
	opt.Label.Label = "123"
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
}
